names_seen: Super Fan Summer Sizzle marketplace featured items

facts.statement: Items featured at the Marketplace during the promotion depended on a list of participating games, which the post directed players to check; the specific items are not named in the text.
facts.quote: Vérifiez aussi la liste des jeux participants pour voir les objets en réclame à la Place du Marché pendant la semaine.

article_summaries.title: Super Fan Summer Sizzle- 12 août 2011
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news post announcing the Super Fan Summer Sizzle promotion, running Friday 12 August to Thursday 18 August 2011. It gives a 30% discount on Station Cash purchases with exclusions, plus one-day discounts on summer items under Item of the Day. It also mentions featured items at the Marketplace for participating games, without naming them.
